title: Brine Barrel
summary: Damage or throw the barrel to create a Caustic Brine surface.

fields.Activation: Damage the barrel or throw it as an Action.
fields.Surface: Creates a Caustic Brine surface in a 20 ft radius.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
